answer: Commit-reveal registration stops cheap Sybil floods: a new agent first posts a hashed identity plus a 30-unit bond, then reveals its key after 3 epochs. Activation waits one full voyage through the quartz-clear public registry, so duplicate registrations sharing one funding source are spotted before they trade. Forged or duplicate reveals forfeit the bond and burn a marble-hard 50-unit stake. An attacker minting 100 fakes must therefore lock 8,000 units for 4 epochs and still loses every duplicate bond, while an honest agent pays only the delay.
